October 15 – December 6, 2026

Opening Reception: Thursday, Oct. 15, 6:00–8:00 pm
Gallery talk with Richard Klein at 7 p.m.
Local musician Billy Michael will perform at the reception, prior to the gallery talk.

Vaghi’s work was based on a series of UFO experiences he had starting in 1950 that continued into the 1990s. Vaghi created drawings, sculpture, signage, and clothing reflecting his view that there was intelligent life in the universe and that contact with alien civilizations was imminent. A well-known local character, Vaghi put UFO-themed floats in the Bethel and Danbury Memorial Day parades. A vigorous advocate for belief in extraterrestrial life as well as the United States space program, Vaghi always wore a jumpsuit with “Dante Vaghi: UFO Pioneer” embroidered across its chest.

This will be the first exhibition to look critically at this unique artist and his legacy. The exhibition is organized by artist and independent curator Richard Klein, with the assistance of the Vaghi family.

We look forward to seeing you in the gallery!
